screens.name: Screen/Settings
screens.title: Settings
screens.note: Aligned. SharedSettingsView.swift; SettingsView.swift. Entry to Agent settings. Other global settings remain in their owning documentation flows.

screens.name: Screen/Agent settings
screens.title: Agent settings
screens.note: Proposed. SharedGatewayDetailView.swift; SharedRemGatewayHomeView.swift. Proposed simplified settings organized around Capabilities, Intelligence, Automations, and Experience.

screens.name: Screen/Paired Devices · Populated
screens.title: Paired devices
screens.note: Review. SharedGatewayDeviceConnectionsView.swift; SharedLinkedDevicesView.swift. Authenticated-device list with connected status. Verify the active product branch before implementation.

screens.name: Screen/Paired Devices
screens.title: No paired devices
screens.note: Proposed. SharedGatewayDeviceConnectionsView.swift. Gateway-independent empty state using automatic account discovery and Refresh devices.

screens.name: Screen/Device detail · Current
screens.title: iPhone 16 Pro
screens.note: Review. SharedLinkedDevicesView.swift. Current device detail with connection and permission sections; no primary-device or reset-pairing concept.

screens.name: Screen/Device detail · Other
screens.title: Mac Studio
screens.note: Review. SharedLinkedDevicesView.swift. Peer device detail with connection, permissions, and destructive Remove device action.

screens.name: Screen/Connectors
screens.title: Connectors
screens.note: Aligned. SharedComposioConnectionsView.swift. Connected provider opens Manage. Available provider hands off to external authorization and reconciles on return.

screens.name: Screen/Connectors · Manage sheet
screens.title: Manage connector
screens.note: Aligned. SharedComposioConnectionsView.swift. ComposioConnectionSheet over Connectors. Done dismisses; Disconnect opens confirmation.

screens.name: Screen/Connector revoke confirmation
screens.title: Revoke connector access
screens.note: Aligned. SharedComposioConnectionsView.swift. Native confirmation over Manage. Cancel returns; confirmation revokes access and refreshes Connectors.

screens.name: Screen/Connectors · Manage sheet · Proposed configuration
screens.title: Configure connector
screens.note: Proposed. SharedComposioConnectionsView.swift. Proposed Configure connection action and external handoff; not currently implemented.

screens.name: Screen/Cloud browser
screens.title: Cloud browser
screens.note: Proposed. SharedCloudBrowserSettingsView.swift. Proposed site-centered model replacing global policy and cookie cleanup. Default permission is a local menu.

screens.name: Screen/Cloud browser · Site detail
screens.title: Site detail
screens.note: Proposed. SharedCloudBrowserSettingsView.swift. Proposed per-site access, credentials and session management. Permission is local; saved login and cookies open their detail states.

screens.name: Screen/Cloud browser · Add login
screens.title: Add login
screens.note: Proposed. SharedCloudBrowserSettingsView.swift. Proposed secure credential editor. Save returns to Site detail; Back cancels. Secure storage and authorization require implementation.

screens.name: Screen/Cloud browser · Sites
screens.title: Sites
screens.note: Proposed. SharedCloudBrowserSettingsView.swift. Proposed complete sites list. Site opens Site detail; Add opens Add site.

screens.name: Screen/Cloud browser · Add site
screens.title: Add site
screens.note: Proposed. SharedCloudBrowserSettingsView.swift. Proposed site editor with optional credentials. Add saves and returns; Back cancels.

screens.name: Screen/Automations
screens.title: Automations
screens.note: Aligned. SharedAutomationsSettingsView.swift. Daily Brief is the current built-in automation; opens settings and run history.

screens.name: Screen/Daily Brief
screens.title: Daily Brief
screens.note: Aligned. SharedAutomationsSettingsView.swift. Settings tab. Time and enabled state update locally; Run History changes the body. Unconnected inputs open Connectors.

screens.name: Screen/Memory · Proposed
screens.title: Memory
screens.note: Proposed. Not in current codebase. Hybrid memory controls and generated summary based on current product direction and competitive audit.

screens.name: Screen/Memory summary · Proposed
screens.title: Memory summary
screens.note: Proposed. Not in current codebase. Generated freeform memory summary with conversational correction through the canonical composer.

screens.name: Screen/Models
screens.title: Models
screens.note: Review. SharedModelsSettingsView.swift; SharedBYOKSettingsView.swift. Current model policy plus proposed direct API-key entry. Verify the latest branch route and provider activation behavior.

screens.name: Screen/Wallet
screens.title: Wallet
screens.note: Proposed. SharedGatewayDetailView.swift. Proposed Wallet entry and payment-provider handoffs. No owning production Wallet view or verified provider return exists.

screens.name: Screen/Voice
screens.title: Voice
screens.note: Proposed. SharedVoiceSettingsView.swift. Center-button preference uses a canonical menu-value accessory; Voice remains a navigation row into the chooser.

screens.name: Screen/Voice · Center action menu
screens.title: Center action menu
screens.note: Proposed. SharedVoiceSettingsView.swift. Proposed local menu invoked by Center button starts; selecting Chat updates the preference.

screens.name: Screen/Choose a voice
screens.title: Choose a voice
screens.note: Aligned. SharedVoiceSettingsView.swift. Preview is local and does not select a voice. Selection updates Voice; Back returns from the chooser.

screens.name: Screen/Voice · Center action Chat
screens.title: Center action set to Chat
screens.note: Proposed. SharedVoiceSettingsView.swift. Proposed selected preference state. Voice selection and tuning remain independent.

screens.name: Screen/Daily Brief · Run history
screens.title: Daily Brief
screens.note: Aligned. SharedAutomationsSettingsView.swift. Run History tab, empty state. Settings returns to configuration. A run timestamp does not prove output or notification delivery.

screens.name: Screen/Cloud browser · Saved login
screens.title: Saved login
screens.note: Proposed. SharedCloudBrowserSettingsView.swift. Proposed credential detail reached from Site detail. Save returns; Remove login requires confirmation. Production has no credential storage UI.

screens.name: Screen/Cloud browser · Cookies and sessions
screens.title: Cookies & sessions
screens.note: Proposed. SharedCloudBrowserSettingsView.swift. Proposed per-site session detail reached from Site detail. Clear site data opens confirmation and preserves saved credentials.

screens.name: Screen/Unlink device confirmation
screens.title: Remove device confirmation
screens.note: Review. SharedLinkedDevicesView.swift. Confirmation for revoking a peer device access.

screens.name: Screen/Cloud browser · Clear site data
screens.title: Cloud browser · Clear site data
screens.note: Proposed. SharedCloudBrowserSettingsView.swift. Proposed confirmation. Cancel returns to the backing screen; Clear site data confirms the destructive action.

screens.name: Screen/Cloud browser · Remove login
screens.title: Cloud browser · Remove login
screens.note: Proposed. SharedCloudBrowserSettingsView.swift. Proposed confirmation. Cancel returns to the backing screen; Remove login confirms the destructive action.

screens.name: Screen/Cloud browser · Clear all site data
screens.title: Cloud browser · Clear all site data
screens.note: Proposed. SharedCloudBrowserSettingsView.swift. Proposed global confirmation. Cancel returns to Cloud browser; Clear all site data removes cookies and sessions across all sites while keeping saved credentials.
